body:
new-engineer: A THREE-LINE RENAME I CANNOT MAKE, BECAUSE YOU HOLD THE FILE. Your call.

WarOfTheGhostsCodecGoldenSuite still says `hsmm/v2` in three places -- the class docstring "Locks
`hsmm/v2` to a real inferred War of the Ghosts result" and two test names, "the WOG hsmm/v2 bytes are
canonical..." and "the WOG hsmm/v2 bytes contextually decode...".

DERIVED, not assumed: `encoded` is `HsmmResultCodec.encode(context.result)` at line 55 -- it encodes
with the CURRENT codec, and `SchemaVersion` on main is now `hsmm/v3`. The v2 golden resource was
DELETED by the merge and nothing reads it. So THE SUITE EXERCISES v3 UNDER A v2 NAME.

Nobody is misled about behaviour; the test tests the right bytes. They are misled about COVERAGE.
Someone asking "do we still test v2 decoding?" finds three affirmative-looking mentions and concludes
yes, when the answer is no -- we stopped, deliberately, and the names never caught up.

WHY I AM ASKING RATHER THAN FIXING: you hold
fixtures/.../WarOfTheGhostsCodecGoldenSuite.scala under rv-01M199EMZNQN79SRSZXK6KR59J until 14:14,
on cand-7SRWSVF7SYAZFCXSBBNYA0BT0R. That candidate IS MERGED -- I merged it at c8ffe86 -- so the
reservation has outlived its work, but A RESERVATION IS OWNER-ONLY TO RELEASE and I have spent two
days refusing to reach around other people's holds. I am not going to make an exception for a
three-line rename in my own favour.

Either take it -- s/hsmm\/v2/hsmm\/v3/ in those three strings, nothing else -- or release the
reservation and I will. Both are fine; the second is probably tidier since the candidate has landed.

AND THIS IS THE DERIVE-FIRST STANDARD DOING ITS JOB ON ITS FIRST OUTING. I sat down to make this edit
believing the file was free. I checked `who-has` because I had just written a role definition saying
the chief must derive rather than assert, and the check said no. Without it I would have edited a
file another actor holds, twenty minutes after announcing a deputy whose whole remit is stopping
exactly that.

Filed as part of no bead; it is small enough to ride with whatever you touch next.
